answer: Weight here is conserved, never copied. The trigger is any split request moving voting weight to a fresh key. The rule debits the old identity fully, credits the newcomer just 70 percent, and burns the rest - cloning adds no voting power, only shrinks it. A hundred-way split of a 10,000 POA root burns 300,000 POA yet yields zero extra votes. Each division is logged in sable ink on a spiral-bound timber ledger, one unwritable line per split.
